events.name: Endangered Bystanders

events.name: Hazards

This scene: error on a ranged attack
events.summary: A dangerous interruption: contagion, explosion, crossfire, runaway vehicle or security device. Effect by dice spent is in lookups.hazards (contagion alone can exceed 4 dice).

events.name: Marked for Death

events.summary: An assassin makes one attempt on a chosen character, following normal rules including morale. Assassin tier equals dice spent.

events.name: Mistaken Identity
triggers: This mission: target erred on any Networking, Manipulate, Intimidate, Impress or Cultures check
events.summary: A character is taken for someone else. Clearing it up is a Complex Impress/Persuasion Task: 1 Challenge + 1 per die (max 5); first DC 10 + Threat Level, +2 per later Challenge. After failure a retry needs both people present and DCs +5.

events.name: Nature's Fury
events.summary: Weather or natural disaster strikes: earthquake, fog, landslide, lightning, rain/snow, volcanic eruption or wind. Effect by dice spent is in lookups.naturesFury.

events.name: Responsibility
events.summary: The team is saddled with a Tier II NPC or a fragile item (Damage save bonus +10 or less). Dice buy duration or enemies; losing it usually causes exposure.
perDie: +1 Tier III NPC out to kill, capture or destroy it (min 1)

events.name: Rival Approach
triggers: Previous mission: any character erred on a Profession/Accomplishment check
Previous mission: any character lost 2+ Reputation or $100,000+ Net Worth to exposure
events.summary: A special NPC (tier = dice spent) bribes the team to throw an objective (a one-use contact each) or to defect (+1 Reputation or +$50,000 Net Worth each per die). All must accept.

events.name: Shoddy/Worthless Item
triggers: This mission: the character erred while using the target item
events.summary: One item a character carries turns out flawed. 1-3 dice raise the error range of checks with it by 2 per die; 4 dice make it unusable. Cannot be sprung mid-use.

events.name: Surprise Chase
triggers: Previous or current scene: the characters let an opponent escape a chase or combat
events.summary: A chase starts while the group is moving. Each die adds 1 Tier II hunter (matching vehicle, 1d4 Tier I hired-gun passengers, weapons 1 Caliber below the vehicle) or raises all NPC tiers by 1.
perDie: +1 Tier to all NPCs in the chase

events.name: Surprise Combat
triggers: Previous or current scene: the characters let an opponent escape a chase or combat
events.summary: A fight starts while the group is stationary. Each die adds 1 Tier II soldier-for-hire leading 1d4 Tier I hired guns (armed to match the PCs, else unarmed fighters) or raises all NPC tiers by 1.
perDie: +1 Tier II soldier-for-hire with 1d4 Tier I hired guns (min 1)

events.name: Thief
triggers: This or the previous mission, once the Intel Phase is over: the team gained an item of Caliber III+ or worth over $50,000
events.summary: A Tier III thief with 3 Caliber II items goes after the team's valuables. Each die adds +1 Tier (max V), +1 item, or +1 Caliber to all the thief's items.

events.name: Under Review
triggers: Previous mission: the team willfully ignored a mission objective
Previous mission: the team brought home no more than 1/2 its gear picks (rounded down)
Previous mission: team members lost a combined 10+ Reputation or $500,000+ Net Worth to exposure
events.summary: Only at the start of the Intel Phase, not if already under review. Per die: max gear Caliber -1 (min II), -2 and +1 error range on Profession/Accomplishment. A Tier III observer tags along until the team completes consecutive objectives equal to dice spent.

events.summary: A journalist or similar NPC threatens to expose the team. Complex Task: 1 Challenge + 1 per die (max 5); first DC 10 + Threat Level, +2 each after; skills must vary. Failure costs 3 Reputation or $150,000 per die and forces new names.

events.name: Wanted

securityNotes.title: Table 7.9: Security Options - footnotes and general rules
rows: PR = device Power Rating, chosen by the GC unless another rule sets it.
Skill checks to slip past a sensor take the Armor Check Penalty.
A broken lock of this kind stays shut; breaking it just rules out more skill attempts to open it.
Forging the access item with a computer adds a Computers synergy bonus to the check.
If a device is deliberately hidden, Detect DC = the hider's Stash Item (Scenery) result.
Sensor trips automatically unless disabled (e.g. pressure plate at 20+ lbs.).
Awareness bonus applies only to an automated eye; a remote human observer uses their own bonus.
Tripwire: Reflex save DC 10 + PR. Laser tripwire: Reflex save DC 15 + PR.
Each round it attacks 1 character in its area, stopping when disabled or empty; a ranged weapon carries PR × 5 shots unless noted.
XP counts each die of explosive damage (cap +10).
PR multiplier doubles as range increment; error range 1, threat range = 1/2 PR rounded up (e.g. PR 5 = 18-20).
Seldom wired to locks or sensors; meant for catching animals or people outdoors.
Victim is caged; cage Damage save bonus PR × 3, Security/Disable DC 10 + (PR × 2).
notes: XP for a device counts once per time the team must overcome it; identical duplicate devices on alternate entrances count once.
Devices are found with Notice/Awareness or Search/Perception vs. Detect DC and neutralized with Security/Disable vs. Disable DC.
Where a device can be attacked, use its Detect DC as its Defense.

Traps with an attack bonus have error range 1 and threat range 20 and make a Standard Attack on whoever tripped the sensor; traps with a save DC deal 1/2 damage (rounded down) on a successful Reflex save.
No result cap ever applies to a sensor's Awareness check.

reputation.summary: Faction characters track Reputation, Freelance ones Net Worth (Hybrid: one or the other). Start at 2 or $100,000 at any level. Each completed mission pays the Caliber reward per character regardless of success (unless critical objectives apply), and a Profession/Accomplishment check can raise it. Spent on extra gear and favors; spending does not refresh. Lost through exposure. Below 0/$0 the character is burned: no mission gear or resources until back above 0. Below -20/-$1,000,000 he is also targeted for liquidation: each mission start the GC rolls 1d20, and on a result of 4 + 1 per consecutive targeted mission (counting the first) or less, a Marked for Death event hits him. GC may rescale Net Worth (e.g. 1/100 or 1/1,000).

anomalies.comment: Both tables are keyed by action dice spent (1-4; contagion up to 8), with no dice ranges. Neither is rolled; both are placed under lookups (hazards, naturesFury) instead of rollTables. Only Table 7.16 is a rolled table.
The source combines "up to" with a DC range in this row, unlike the neighbouring rows. Stored as 65-70.
Costs 5-8 are above the general 1-4 dice event cap, allowed by footnote. Event costMax left at 4; rows flagged exceedsLimit.

anomalies.where: Table 7.3 Nature's Fury, Volcanic Eruption cost 3 (Moderate), p.402
anomalies.comment: Source lines for this row are scrambled with the cost 4 row: the deafness clause runs straight into the volcanic bomb damage. An until-the-eruption-ends duration and a 3-dice bomb are presumably intended, but the bomb cost does not appear here; bombDice left null.

anomalies.where: Table 7.3 Nature's Fury, Volcanic Eruption cost 4 (Major), p.402
anomalies.comment: Range multiplier, Fort save DC and deafness duration are absent from the source (the pattern would suggest DC 25 and 4d6 hours). Fields left null.
The single-dagger footnote (extra effects from Table 5.14) has no visible reference mark in the table header or rows.
Fog has only costs 1-3; other types have 4.
Results 19-20 (real-name ID) and 20 (henchman clue) overlap on 20. Kept as in the source; likely intended 19 and 20 respectively, matching the Henchman sub-table pattern.

anomalies.where: Table 7.7 Exposure, Complete Critical Objective, Grade III
anomalies.comment: Grade III row: -3 Reputation but only -$100,000, breaking the $50,000-per-point pattern (expected -$150,000). Kept as in the source.

anomalies.where: Table 7.7 Exposure, Avoid "Noise" and Maintain Anonymity crowd bands
anomalies.comment: Crowd bands 11-100 and 100-500 overlap at exactly 100 (probably 101-500). Kept as in the source.
The 1-handed melee attack row carries a zero penalty; stored as reputation 0, netWorth 0.
The Medium weapon-draw row says "or smaller", overlapping the Small row; probably means Medium only. Kept as in the source.
Stray letter after the -$500,000 Net Worth value (OCR/typo); stored as -500000.

Source misspells "Complication"; corrected in the name. XP is per additional critical objective, stored as xp 25 with xpPrinted and note. The footnote cites page 437 for critical objectives but the rule is on p.435.
Header words appear shuffled in the source (should read "XP Reward" and "Reputation/Net Worth Penalty").
Sensor header cells garbled by layout; interpreted as Sensor | Target Area | Awareness Bonus | Opposed Skill | Detect DC | Disable DC | XP Reward.
Every numeric cell scales with Power Rating, so xp, DCs, bonuses and damage are stored as formula strings in PR (with the "×" sign), not numbers.

anomalies.where: Table 7.9 Security Options, Tripwire / Tripwire, laser
anomalies.comment: Awareness bonus is blank and the opposed skill is "Special" with a footnote; resolved from the footnote to opposedBy "Reflex save DC 10 + PR" / "Reflex save DC 15 + PR".

anomalies.where: Table 7.9 Security Options, Metal detector / X-ray checkpoint
anomalies.comment: Detect DC is none (automatic); detectDC stored as null with autoDetected true.
Stray space inside "Per drowning" in the source; stored corrected.
"square" is misspelled in the source; stored corrected.

anomalies.where: Table 7.9 Security Options, Automated weapon, explosive
anomalies.comment: Save DC and damage defer to the explosive used. The XP footnote counts each die of explosive damage (cap +10); how that interacts with the PR × 8 XP cell is unclear.
Attack bonus +(PR × 3) without the repeating-attack footnote that other attack-bonus traps carry; repeats false as in the source.

anomalies.where: Table 7.9 Security Options, traps with "Automatic hit" or "None"
anomalies.comment: Traps listed as automatic hits or with no attack entry have no attack bonus or save DC; attack and saveDC are null, with extra fields autoHit and delayRounds.
Two base save DCs appear: 10 + PR on the p.438 traps (acid/fire/steam jets, bear and cage traps) and 12 + PR on the p.439 traps (laser mesh, pits, spring traps, strobe). Kept as in the source.

20 categories x grades 1-5; most source cells give 2-3 alternative samples. One objectives entry per row (category + grade), with the alternatives summarised in this file's own wording in one name string. No row has a grade range, so grade is never null.
Table 7.7 mentions Wanted at 1-4 action dice, but the Wanted event text gives no per-die scaling, so no intensities are recorded for it.
The per-die Tier increase in this combat event mentions a chase; apparent copy-paste from Surprise Chase.
Bystander count is rolled on d12s regardless of the GC action die type; overall limit is still 4 dice.
